title: Unemployment Insurance Act 63 of 2001
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Unemployment Insurance Act 63 of 2001'. Commencement: 1 April 2002 (Gazette 23283). Amended by Labour Laws Amendment Act 10 of 2018 among others.
notes: The UIF pays maternity, parental, adoption and illness benefits during unpaid leave under the BCEA.
